attributions.title: Add fractions with unlike denominators

explanation: Use 4 as the least common denominator. The least common denominator is 4.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator. 1 over 4 equals 1 over 4.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator. 1 over 2 equals 2 over 4.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator. 1 plus 2 over 4 is 3 over 4.
Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms. 3 over 4 is already in lowest terms.
Use 8 as the least common denominator. The least common denominator is 8.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator. 1 over 4 equals 2 over 8.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator. 7 over 8 equals 7 over 8.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator. 2 plus 7 over 8 is 9 over 8.
Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms. 9 over 8 is already in lowest terms.
Use 12 as the least common denominator. The least common denominator is 12.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator. 1 over 3 equals 4 over 12.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator. 1 over 4 equals 3 over 12.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator. 4 plus 3 over 12 is 7 over 12.
Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms. 7 over 12 is already in lowest terms.
Use 21 as the least common denominator. The least common denominator is 21.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator. 1 over 7 equals 3 over 21.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator. 1 over 3 equals 7 over 21.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator. 3 plus 7 over 21 is 10 over 21.
Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms. 10 over 21 is already in lowest terms.
Use 40 as the least common denominator. The least common denominator is 40.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator. 5 over 8 equals 25 over 40.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator. 2 over 5 equals 16 over 40.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator. 25 plus 16 over 40 is 41 over 40.
Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms. 41 over 40 is already in lowest terms.
Use 6 as the least common denominator. The least common denominator is 6.
Rewrite the first addend with the common denominator. 5 over 6 equals 5 over 6.
Rewrite the second addend with the common denominator. 1 over 3 equals 2 over 6.
Add the numerators while keeping the common denominator. 5 plus 2 over 6 is 7 over 6.
Check the fraction. It is already in lowest terms. 7 over 6 is already in lowest terms.
